# Direct file reads that tests/direct_file_reads.rs allows in src/.
#
# Each line: the number of direct read calls (std::fs::read, read_to_string,
# File::open, image::open, ImageReader::open, Mmap::map) that a source file
# can have outside its test code. A file that is not here can have none.
#
# The numbers are the reads that were in src/ on 2026-11-19. They do not say
# that each of these reads is on the correct thread: some run on a worker,
# some read a small file of the app (a setting, a lock, a cache), and some
# read a user's file on the UI thread and are to move to a worker.
#
# To add a read of a user's file: run it through `background_task`
# (src/app/update/file.rs). If the new read already runs on a worker, or it
# reads a small file of the app itself, raise the file's number and give the
# reason after a `#` on its line.
#
# A number that is too high does not fail. To find them:
#   cargo test --test integration direct_file_reads -- --ignored
